note: Monroe County, Ohio does not publish a zoning district layer. The county GIS Hub lists no zoning service; the county's Subdivision Regulations cover unincorporated land, and in Ohio zoning there is by township resolution (ORC 519), not county. The county seat Village of Woodsfield publishes its zoning only as codified ordinance text, with no map or service. Clarington and Lewisville are villages with no published zoning GIS found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Monroe County OH zoning returned only floodplain and abstract-review layers. (Monroe County, Indiana's zoning pages were found but are a different county.)
